title: M100 power overshoot quantification
query_text: For the rack 10 power event, quantify how much extra power the offending node is drawing above the rack baseline.

eval_criteria.gold_answer: The offending node r10n4 is drawing power far above its rack-10 peer baseline — a sustained overshoot that exceeds the 1300W sustained per-node alert threshold in the node power policy. The other rack-10 nodes remain near the normal baseline, so this is a single-node anomaly rather than a rack-wide event.
